title: beta-Caryophyllene (CB2 agonist) mitigates rotenone-induced neurotoxicity and apoptosis in SH-SY5Y neuroblastoma cells via modulation of GSK-3beta/NRF2/HO-1 axis.
authors: Rathod, Sumit S; Agrawal, Yogeeta O
one_liner_zh: 该文研究β-石竹烯对鱼藤酮诱导神经毒性的保护作用，涉及小分子与蛋白的分子对接，但对象为小分子-蛋白互作，非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Rotenone-induced neurotoxicity in SH-SY5Y cells is an essential hallmark of neurodegenerative diseases like Alzheimer's disease (AD) and Parkinson's disease (PD). beta-Caryophyllene (BCP), a cannabinoid receptor 2 (CB2) agonist, has anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and cytoprotective efficacy. The involvement of the GSK-3beta/NRF2/HO-1 axis in neuroprotection has garnered attention as a possible mechanism for BCP to exhibit multitargeted neuroprotective effects. Hence, this study investigates the effects of BCP against rotenone-induced neurotoxicity and apoptosis in SH-SY5Y cells, focusing on the involvement of the GSK-3beta/NRF2/HO-1 signaling pathway. Initially, we performed the in silico molecular docking of BCP with GSK-3beta, NRF2, and HO-1 proteins to ensure the degree of binding affinities. The in vitro MTT assay was performed to evaluate cell viability, followed by the assessment of biomarkers such as LDH leakage, oxidative stress, reactive species, caspase 3 activity, pro-inflammatory markers, and GSK-3beta, NRF2, and HO-1 proteins in BCP, as well as specific receptor modulators (chir98023 and quercetin) against the rotenone pre-treated cells. In silico molecular docking studies revealed that BCP exhibits a strong binding affinity for GSK-3beta, NRF2, and HO-1 proteins. Also, in vitro studies revealed that BCP (100 microg/ml), as compared to the rotenone-treated group, significantly restored cell viability (72%). Moreover, BCP significantly modulates cell cytotoxicity (LDH leakage), pro-apoptotic, pro-inflammatory, reactive species, and oxidative stress markers. Molecular docking established robust binding affinities of BCP with GSK-3beta, NRF2, and HO-1 proteins. Furthermore, protein estimation by ELISA confirmed the BCP-mediated modulation of these pathways. These findings suggest that BCP protects SH-SY5Y cells from rotenone-induced neurotoxicity, offering a potential therapeutic candidate for neurodegenerative diseases like AD.
abstract_zh: 鱼藤酮诱导的SH-SY5Y细胞神经毒性是阿尔茨海默病（AD）和帕金森病（PD）等神经退行性疾病的重要标志。β-石竹烯（BCP），一种大麻素受体2（CB2）激动剂，具有抗炎、抗氧化和细胞保护作用。GSK-3β/NRF2/HO-1轴在神经保护中的参与已引起关注，可能作为BCP发挥多靶点神经保护效应的机制。因此，本研究探讨BCP对鱼藤酮诱导的SH-SY5Y细胞神经毒性和凋亡的影响，重点关注GSK-3β/NRF2/HO-1信号通路的参与。首先，我们进行了BCP与GSK-3β、NRF2和HO-1蛋白的计算机模拟分子对接，以确保结合亲和力的程度。随后进行体外MTT实验以评估细胞活力，并评估生物标志物，如LDH泄漏、氧化应激、活性物种、caspase 3活性、促炎标志物以及BCP中的GSK-3β、NRF2和HO-1蛋白，同时使用特异性受体调节剂（chir98023和槲皮素）处理鱼藤酮预处理的细胞。计算机模拟分子对接研究显示，BCP对GSK-3β、NRF2和HO-1蛋白表现出强结合亲和力。此外，体外研究表明，与鱼藤酮处理组相比，BCP（100微克/毫升）显著恢复细胞活力（72%）。而且，BCP显著调节细胞毒性（LDH泄漏）、促凋亡、促炎、活性物种和氧化应激标志物。分子对接确立了BCP与GSK-3β、NRF2和HO-1蛋白的强结合亲和力。进一步通过ELISA蛋白定量确认了BCP介导的这些通路调节。这些发现表明，BCP保护SH-SY5Y细胞免受鱼藤酮诱导的神经毒性，为AD等神经退行性疾病提供了潜在的治疗候选药物。
